programmes.d: Find out what goes into the electrical wiring on a new age Super Car....not as much as you might think.
Every muscle car should have the power to match its looks, so Bryan and Byrd add a monster overdrive transmission to a 1972 Chevelle.
Kevin and Bryan bring out their 1977 CB550 motorcycle project. Kevin handles the electronics and Bryan custom fabricates the exhaust.
Kevin and Bryan begin work on a custom 1930's roadster. This is not your typical roadster renovation...it is a true custom build up that begins with fabricating the frame from scratch!
Kevin and Bryan continue re-building our 67 Camaro by rebuilding the quadra-jet carburetor.
Bryan does some welding on a 66 Nova while Kevin takes a trip to the dyno to dial in the new EFI system for the small block engine.
Bryan tightens the bumper on a 1969 Chevy Van and Kevin lights a fire with the wrong gauge wire.
Matt and Bruno bring in a pair of Toyota Tundra's. The only problem, what truck gets what parts? Let the competition begin.
Its our first look at the Ford EcoBoost V6 engine, and we don't leave anything stock. We'll keep the more efficient engine and add some power today on Truck U.

Why build a regular work truck, when you can build the Ultimate Work Truck. Our challenge today is to take a stock 2013 Silverado and outfit it from head to toe, and when we're done, we're giving it away.
We start with a 2012 stock Jeep JK and build it up to get ready to go off-road only at the massive Jeep Beach Event at Daytona International speedway.
Our Truck Ubicon Jeep Beach Rig is done. Now it's time to use it. We'll hit the obstacles at Daytona Motor Speedway and see some of the coolest rigs along the way.
Why spend thousands, when you can do it yourself. Bruno and Matt show you how to fix faulty injectors on a Ford F250 Diesel.
Matt and Bruno take a stock Ford Truck and turn it in to a very cool one-off, all-white Storm Trooper Ford.
Matt and Bruno show you some cool upgrades for your Razor UTV. Then it's time to strap the toys down and hit the trail.
Bryan and Kevin put a stop to the shakes on a 2006 Nissan. Also find out what happened when a graffiti artist put his mark on our garage.
Bryan and Kevin marry an engine transmission and work on patch panels for the Nova project.
Ride along with Kevin Byrd as he takes a pilgrimage to Plymouth with some of his Factory Five friends.
1967 Camaro wiring issues get cleaned up.
The Impala is back and ready to breath with a new Kinsler intake.
Bryan rips apart a brand new Buelle to give it the Fuller touch.
Sam Memmolo is back to match wits with Kevin about the new 6.7 diesel Cummins.
Kevin and Bryan install a new exhaust kit on a new Challenger and then start work on Bryan's 33 getting it ready for a chop.
Matt and Bruno find a 1971 Chevy Truck that needs a major restoration update. This truck gets transformed inside and out to feel 30 years younger.
Nobody wants a truck payment. But, everyone wants the newest technology. Matt and Bruno show you how to get your older truck up to date without trading it in on the new model.
Matt and Bruno find the perfect hunting truck, the only problem is they need to get it running before they can go on their first hunt.
Some build Jeeps to go off-road, and others build them just for the "off-road" look. Matt and Bruno will show you how to build the ultimate "Mall Crawler" on Truck U.
How can you jump a Ford Raptor even further? Put a supercharger in it. Matt and Bruno team up with Roush Performance to get the maximum power output of a stock Raptor.
Bruno and Matt find a vintage CJ Jeep and see if they can transform it back to its former glory.
Bruno goes racing in Charlotte, North Carolina. First, he finds out how a NASCAR team is run at Michael Waltrip Racing; then he checks out a NHRA test session at zMAX Dragway.
Every Project starts with a Cab and Chassis. On Truck U will show you what to look for when finding the right cab and get a small block engine wired and fired.
Bryan finally gets to fulfill his dream of chopping the top on his 33.
Kevin and Bryan begin work on a new Factory Five Hot Rod with a Dart 369 engine build
Bryan and Kevin get the body on their Factory Five Hot Rod
Kevin and Bryan finish their five-day Factory Five project and take their car to the streets.
Learn some Mig and Tig welding tips as the guys finish the roll cage and do some patch panels on the Fuller Hot Rod Project.
How do you a make a 2010 SS throw back Camaro look even better. Drop it off with Kevin and Bryan and see what happens.
Kevin installs a new wiring harness while Bryan welds up a new exhaust for our Nova.
Kevin visits Magnaflow to see what it takes to get that perfect sounding exhaust.
Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the bed of a 1966 Chevy truck.
The world's largest food truck rally comes to Truck U. Matt and Bruno find a Food Truck that is need of some repair and in the process give the truck a whole new look.
A local seafood distributor is ready to grow his business and Truck U is ready to help. Matt and Bruno find a truck, find a work bed and fill it up with seafood.
Can Am Commanders are perfect for work and play. On Truck U we do a little of both.
When 4 Wheel Parts ask Truck U to build a signature series Jeep, we said yes. We'll add a long arm suspension kit with 37 inch tires and take the new JK off-road.
Desert Race Teams need support when they're in the middle of nowhere. We'll help one of those teams, by turning a stock Raptor SVT into the Ultimate Chase Truck.
When it takes almost 900 horsepower to pull a pro sled truck down a track, things are going to break. Truck U steps in, to take out broken axles and upgrade them for good.
Matt and Bruno bring in a 1982 GMC that has a lot of show and even more go. They'll do some custom modifications to the Cummins engine and dress up the exterior.
The ghouls work on a 1968 GTX for Bill Goldberg, and Mark repairs a Challenger deck lid. Will paints a 1967 Hemi GTX and challenges Mark to a paint-off.
